name: Sherco SE / SEF enduro
engine: 125 to 500 cc liquid-cooled two- or four-stroke single
intro: Sherco's French enduros. SE models are two-strokes, SEF are four-strokes, both with short service intervals.

B: SE models are two-strokes that run premix. SEF models are four-strokes. Check which one you have.

recallNote: Off-road and trials models are often not in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a dealer for the make to run the frame number.
